description:
Your value isn’t determined by who recognizes it. 

The 99% stay where they're not valued. The 1% walk away and trust God as their source.
transcript: Hey, if they don't see value in you, go somewhere else. Go somewhere else. They ain't the only ones that can blow you up. They ain't the only ones that can feed you. They ain't the only ones that can tell you, the Lord is my sustenance. The Lord is my strength. The Lord is my helper. The Lord is my provider. You ain't that deep. You ain't that deep. You eat, drink, sleep just like I do. You ain't that deep. You ain't that deep. You don't feed me, God feed me. You ain't that deep. You don't see value when I'm going somewhere else.
spoken_hook_0_3s: Hey, if they don't see value in you, go somewhere else.
first_sentence: Hey, if they don't see value in you, go somewhere else.
